description:
Non Material Amendment application for alterations to Planning Permission 01068/42/P2(NMA) including:

"	Re-orientation of ground floor living room and addition of an internal wall between the ground floor front porch and the man house.  
"	Alterations to first floor layout, including addition of WC and re-positioning of Bedroom 2's door.  
"	Increased depth of two single storey rear extension roof lights.  
"	Replacement of single storey front porch's gabled roof with a hipped roof (with increased front projection and rainwater goods) and repositioning of the front door.  
"	Addition of front guttering and rainwater downpipe to two storey side extension.  
"	Replacement of south western triple pane window with a double pane window and first floor rear extension single pane window with double pane window.  
"	Re-organisation of front waste storage areas.  
"	Re-landscaping of front and rear gardens.  
"	Replacement of outbuilding front windows/ door with glazed bifolding doors, internal re-orientation and enlargement of two rooflights.
